'''Body bags''' were bags used to contain the [[Death/Legends|dead]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were used on battlefields to transport fallen soldiers.<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>
